text: Some rural Missouri interstates will soon get a 75 mph speed limit, up from 70, after the Missouri Department of Transportation picked the stretches under a new state law. Lead feet, rejoice responsibly.

Missouri's plan to give every public school and district an A-through-F grade is splitting the State Board of Education, with St. Louis County member Vincent Schoemehl Jr. questioning whether it will help struggling schools. Report cards aren't just for kids anymore.

Missouri Interim Education Commissioner Stacey Preis, who had served since June, resigned Tuesday, effective immediately, as the State Board of Education searches for a permanent leader. Somebody update the job posting.
The Kansas City Chiefs beat the Los Angeles Chargers 22-6 on Sunday to go 5-0, and Patrick Mahomes threw for 272 yards for his 100th career win. Chiefs Kingdom is feeling pretty good.

Number 13 Missouri lost 31-3 at number 9 Ole Miss on Saturday in Oxford, Mississippi, managing only a field goal despite two first-half trips inside the 10, and falling to 5-2. Next Saturday can't come soon enough.
